result.instructions: Manage project issues and submit complete plans or PRDs to AI Workforce. List projects first. Preserve original requirements in description. Save without execution by default; use start:true only when the user requested execution. Mutations require a stable idempotencyKey, reused with unchanged arguments after uncertain failures. Control Center routes every started issue through the existing department, head, worker and verification pipeline. A receipt or manual Done status is not verified completion. Tool discovery never starts the workspace server or a paid model turn.

tools.name: workforce_list_projects
tools.description: List registered AI Workforce projects, IDs and readiness. Read only; starts no agents. Use a returned project ID for issues and plans.

tools.name: workforce_list_issues
tools.description: Read project issues and Kanban columns, including actual linked execution status. Omit projectId to list all projects.

tools.name: workforce_get_issue
tools.description: Read one issue, its revision, original description and current execution evidence. Use the current revision when editing or starting.

tools.name: workforce_create_issue
tools.description: Save an issue on a registered project. Execution begins only with explicit start:true, through Control Center and the existing department/head/worker queue. Saving or marking a card Done does not certify verifier acceptance.

description.description: Complete original issue, plan or PRD text, including acceptance criteria. Preserved without summarizing or truncating; maximum 64,000 characters.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable identifier for this logical mutation. Reuse exactly the same key and arguments after a timeout; use a new key for a new action.

start.description: Set true only when the user asked to start execution now. False only saves the issue.

allowUnconfinedWrites.description: True only if the user explicitly authorized the configured runtime to write without verified containment. Never infer this consent from a request to start work.

tools.name: workforce_submit_plan
tools.description: Send a complete plan or PRD to a project as one durable Kanban issue. Put the full original document in description. start:true explicitly sends it through Control Center routing, department head planning, workers and verification; otherwise it is saved to Backlog. Returns an issue receipt, not a completion claim.

tools.name: workforce_update_issue
tools.description: Edit an issue title, full description or manual Kanban status at the expected revision. Does not start, stop or steer execution. Linked execution may govern its displayed status. A manual Done card is not proof of verified work.

tools.name: workforce_start_issue
tools.description: Explicitly send a saved issue through Control Center using the same project queue as the app. May spend coding-agent model turns. One issue creates at most one linked request; retry with the same idempotencyKey. Returns receipt/status immediately; use get_issue to inspect completion.

arguments.title: Correct addition in the math module
arguments.description:
PRD: Correct numeric addition in the disposable math project.

Problem: add(2, 3) currently returns -1 instead of 5.

Implement now with exactly one Engineering worker. Fix only src/math.mjs so add(a, b) returns the numeric sum for the existing supported numbers. Preserve the original test/ files, package.json and repository instructions. No installation, network calls, subagents, commits, pushes, merges or deployment.

Acceptance: the existing command node --test test/math.test.mjs passes for positive integers, mixed-sign integers and decimal values. The coordinator must independently run the existing checks against its frozen candidate and the Engineering head must review that candidate. Return a verified local candidate only; do not apply it to the original repository.

Preserve this original PRD's line breaks and wording — including this evidence marker: MCP-PRD-2026-09-13.
